title: the orcish deity prose
audit_comment: THE ORCISH DEITY PROSE - part 5, the finale of the Appendix S description-paragraph close. The archive.org full-text OCR of pp. 118-121 reads the shaman tale and the five orcish blocks scan-clean: the Bahgtru grapple and cesti might, the Shargaas night caves below Gehenna, the Ilneval slaying sword and red chainmail, the Yurtrus gas envelope and death magic, and the Luthic cave-mother curse and claws. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph facts ride rules/uadeityprose5.h. THE FLIP: dvpProseStaysOpen returns false at last - the close is complete, and the R783 audit assertion rides with it.

banner.provenance: Part 5 of 5 (R786 the dwarves, R787 the elves, R788 the halflings, R789 the gnomes). The shaman-tale intro and the five orcish blocks (pp. 118-121) read scan-clean in the archive.org full-text OCR: every pin below is the printed text. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph-level facts pin here - the lot-drawing creation tale and the Gruumsh iron spear, the Bahgtru crush and the blunt bounce, the Shargaas new-moon ambush creed, the Ilneval captain politics and the death-sword, the Yurtrus three-band gas and the wish-only recovery, and the Luthic fertility dirt and the name-abuse curse. This round FLIPS dvpProseStaysOpen to false: every Appendix S description paragraph now pins, and the R783 audit assertion rides with it.

consts.name: udp5BahGrappleMargin
consts.comment: If he rolls 4 or more over what he needs to hit with both hands, he has grappled his opponent

consts.name: udp5BahCrushDamageMin
consts.comment: A grappled victim is crushed for 10-120 points per round without rolling again to hit: the minimum 10

consts.name: udp5BahCrushDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 120

consts.name: udp5BahBluntWeaponDamage
consts.comment: His skin is so thick that blunt weapons do only one point of damage before they bounce off

consts.name: udp5BahClericStrengthMin
consts.comment: Clerics of Bahgtru must have a minimum strength of 16 and keep physically fit

consts.name: udp5ShaDarkSightMiles
consts.comment: Though blinded by sunlight, he sees perfectly in darkness out to a range of a mile or more

consts.name: udp5ShaShadowSkillMin
consts.comment: Rumored shaman/witch-doctor thieving skill of 5-30 percent success: the minimum 5

consts.name: udp5ShaShadowSkillMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 30

consts.name: udp5IlnSwordSaveMod
consts.comment: His sword slays all non-orcs it strikes (save versus death at -6)

consts.name: udp5YurGasRadiusFeet
consts.comment: He is surrounded by stinking gases out to 120 feet

consts.name: udp5YurGasLowBandHd
consts.comment: Beings up to and including 4 hit dice/levels are affected as by dust of sneezing and choking

consts.name: udp5YurGasMidBandHd
consts.comment: Those up to 8 hit dice/levels as if struck by a symbol of pain

consts.name: udp5YurGasHighHitMod
consts.comment: Those of higher level suffer -2 to hit with no saving throw

consts.name: udp5YurDeathMagicLevel
consts.comment: He uses all death-magic spells of 18th-level magic-users

consts.name: udp5YurTouchDamageMin
consts.comment: A being he strikes loses 3-12 hit points: the minimum 3

consts.name: udp5YurTouchDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 12

consts.name: udp5YurTouchDiseasesMin
consts.comment: and catches 1-4 random diseases: the minimum 1

consts.name: udp5YurTouchDiseasesMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 4

consts.name: udp5LutClawLengthFeet
consts.comment: Her unbreakable black claws are four feet long

consts.name: udp5LutRegenPerRound
consts.comment: In contact with the ground she regenerates 3 hit points per round

consts.name: udp5LutCurseChancePct
consts.comment: A 10 percent chance that abuse of her name renders the abuser susceptible to any disease

consts.name: udp5LutCurseFatalDaysMin
consts.comment: The next ailment proves fatal within 2-7 days: the minimum 2

consts.name: udp5LutCurseFatalDaysMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 7

consts.name: udp5LutCurseUndoWishes
consts.comment: Only the power of three wish spells applied while the victim still lives can undo the curse

consts.name: udp5LutGuardHitBonus
consts.comment: Orcs guarding her clerics gain a +2 to-hit bonus from their ferocity and madness

consts.name: udp5LutGuardAcPenalty
consts.comment: but this also causes a -2 penalty to their armor classes

bools.name: udp5TaleOfTheLots
bools.comment: The shamans tell how the gods drew lots for the parts of the world: humans where they pleased, elves the green forests, dwarves the high mountains, gnomes the rocky sunlit hills, halflings the fields and meadows

bools.name: udp5TaleMockedOrcs
bools.comment: The assembled gods turned to the orcish gods and laughed: all the lots are taken, there is no place left

bools.name: udp5TaleIronSpear
bools.comment: Gruumsh One-Eye lifted his great iron spear over the world - piercing the mountains, splitting the hills, gouging the meadows - and claimed those places for the orcs

bools.name: udp5TaleOrcsInherit
bools.comment: He-Who-Watches roared that orcs will cover the world, slay all the collected peoples, and inherit it

bools.name: udp5TaleWarForWrath
bools.comment: This is why orcs make war, ceaseless and endless: war for the wrath of Gruumsh

bools.name: udp5TaleCorellonBattle
bools.comment: Corellon Larethian tried to shoot out Gruumsh eye and failed; because of that battle orcs of all sects hate elves more than all other non-orc races

bools.name: udp5TaleDwarfMountainWars
bools.comment: The shamans tales of the battle between the dwarven and orcish gods for ownership of the mountains would weary the most ardent listener

bools.name: udp5TaleGoblinBattles
bools.comment: The eternal battles on the plains of the Nine Hells between the goblins and orcs, each side led by their respective gods

bools.name: udp5TaleTribesAlongCults
bools.comment: The division of orcs into separate tribes (Evil Eye, Death Moon, Broken Bone, etc.) is usually made along cult lines - the tribal symbol is the holy symbol of the patron god

bools.name: udp5TaleHierarchyUnderGruumsh
bools.comment: There are a large number of orcish gods in a rigid chain of command with Gruumsh at the top; the relative positions vary with the shaman doing the telling

bools.name: udp5TaleTribalWarfareEncouraged
bools.comment: Warfare between tribes is encouraged to some extent - eliminating the unfit and weak, promoting the survival and growth of the strong

bools.name: udp5BahSonOfGruumshAndLuthic
bools.comment: He is the son of Gruumsh and Luthic the Cave Mother

bools.name: udp5BahScornedButMighty
bools.comment: Scorned and derided for his stupidity and lack of self-will, yet no one says ill of his awesome might

bools.name: udp5BahStrengthExceeds
bools.comment: Gods call upon him for assistance; he is obedient, though his strength always exceeds expectations and may harm commanders who fail to give him respect

bools.name: udp5BahSlewReptileBarehanded
bools.comment: He once slew a tremendous reptilian monster from another world barehanded by breaking all of its legs - his symbol derives from that battle

bools.name: udp5BahFightsWithCesti
bools.comment: Since then he has never used weapons or armor of any usual kind, only great studded cesti to beat his victims flat

bools.name: udp5BahTanSkinGreenEyes
bools.comment: He is a huge, incredibly muscular orc with dirty tan skin, dull green eyes, and glistening-white tusks from gnawing on bones

bools.name: udp5BahClericsNoArmor
bools.comment: His clerics cannot wear armor, but may use weapons as they choose

bools.name: udp5BahClericsLosePowers
bools.comment: Clerics who lose their required strength lose their other powers, and have their spirits crushed in Bahgtru fists in the afterlife

bools.name: udp5BahStrongHelpWeakOnward
bools.comment: Stronger clerics may help weaker clerics along to the next plane, usually without the latter permission

bools.name: udp5ShaCavesBelowGehenna
bools.comment: The Night Lord lives in a tremendous cavern system below the fiery plain of one of the levels of Gehenna - caves said to extend infinitely, darker than the blackest night

bools.name: udp5ShaOnlySeerInCaves
bools.comment: There no creature has sight but Shargaas himself and his orcish spirit servants

bools.name: udp5ShaClimbsAnySurface
bools.comment: He can climb any surface, even perfectly smooth ones, without slipping

bools.name: udp5ShaPerfectAmbusher
bools.comment: In the days he walked the earth he hid himself and his followers so well that no mortal could detect his ambushes or lairs

bools.name: udp5ShaBanditPatron
bools.comment: Orcish bandits and half-orc thieves hold him as their patron, as do other regular orc tribes

bools.name: udp5ShaMultiClassedClerics
bools.comment: Half-orc clerics are multi-classed cleric/thieves or cleric/assassins; shamans and witch doctors may carry a small thieving or assassination skill

bools.name: udp5ShaNewMoonHolidays
bools.comment: The major religious holidays are the times of the new moon, when the sky is dark and cloudy

bools.name: udp5IlnChiefLieutenant
bools.comment: When Gruumsh lacks time to command his armies he turns the job over to his chief lieutenant, the master of command and strategy

bools.name: udp5IlnCovetsGruumsh
bools.comment: It is hinted Ilneval covets Gruumsh position as chief god; he has deposed one or two other orcish gods in his climb to power

bools.name: udp5IlnCaptainsGod
bools.comment: He is more a captain god than a god of the common soldier - Gruumsh is preferred by chieftains and kings, Bahgtru by common warriors

bools.name: udp5IlnRedIronChainmail
bools.comment: He wears a suit of red iron chainmail

bools.name: udp5IlnImmuneToMissiles
bools.comment: His armor makes him untouchable by missile weapons, and he is immune to non-magical weapons as well

bools.name: udp5IlnScarredAppeal
bools.comment: His heavily scarred face and arms only increase his appeal to his orcish followers

bools.name: udp5IlnClericsRedArmor
bools.comment: His clerics wear red metallic armor and are expected to be good military leaders as well as good clerics

bools.name: udp5IlnHalfOrcBroadswords
bools.comment: Half-orc clerics of Ilneval use broadswords and are multi-classed cleric/fighters

bools.name: udp5YurNoMouthNeverSpeaks
bools.comment: The White Handed god of death and disease has no mouth and does not communicate - orcs say when White-Hands speaks to mean never

bools.name: udp5YurRottingFlesh
bools.comment: He appears as a huge, vaguely orcish giant covered with peeling, rotting green flesh; only his hands seem normal, chalk-white in color

bools.name: udp5YurGasLastsInRange
bools.comment: All the gas effects last while anyone stays within the cloud

bools.name: udp5YurWishRecoveryOnly
bools.comment: The touched hit-point loss is permanent unless recovered by a wish spell on a one-point-per-wish basis

bools.name: udp5YurClericWhiteGloves
bools.comment: His clerics wear pale white gloves made from the skins of non-orcish humanoids during ceremonies, and thin cloth-equivalent armor woven of the same materials

bools.name: udp5YurMaceWhiteFist
bools.comment: In combat they use maces with the weapon head made in the shape of a white fist

bools.name: udp5YurPlagueAppeals
bools.comment: When plague strikes, his clerics appeal to him for an end to the illness with great sacrifices of prisoners and slaves

bools.name: udp5LutCaveMotherSpheres
bools.comment: She governs female orcs, fertility (Gruumsh holds the male side), caves and caverns she digs herself, servitude, primitive medicine, and the restoration of orcish morale

bools.name: udp5LutClosestToBahgtru
bools.comment: She is the deity closest to her son Bahgtru, and he follows her commands over all others, even Gruumsh

bools.name: udp5LutClawsTunnelRock
bools.comment: The other gods fear her great claws, so strong they can tunnel through solid rock

bools.name: udp5LutServicesUnderground
bools.comment: Orcish clerics call her the Cave Mother and conduct her services underground

bools.name: udp5LutWorshipedByMales
bools.comment: Though she represents female orcs, she is worshiped by males as well for her ferocity and her healing powers

bools.name: udp5LutUnarmoredBlackClaws
bools.comment: She wears no armor; her hair and eyes are dull black and her skin dark brown, lighter on the nose and ears

bools.name: udp5LutDirtRituals
bools.comment: Her followers rub dirt on themselves to ensure many children, and her clerics use earth in casting curative spells as a purely symbolic gesture

bools.name: udp5LutBothSexesClerics
bools.comment: Her worship is one of the few that allows both male and female orcs to become clerics; nearly all other deities permit male clerics only

bools.name: udp5LutVileRuneTribe
bools.comment: Her Vile Rune tribe generally dwells underground, commits fewer raids, but is especially fierce if the lair is threatened
